items.title: Israel Gorman Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: something like this fella Louis Armstrong, I stay as close to my melody at all times.

ctx.x: Playing all the wrong notes there.

Well that's the idea. Sometime they'd cover, cover right, and they'd make the notes form, and sometime they'd half-cover, well it was a bad note, but you tell them anything, they'd say, man that note is bad. I said, no that note ain't bad, it's just a passing tone. You mean he was passing, you understand what I mean? And he didn't just pass at the right place, he passed in the wrong spot, you see. Well it's just a bad tone. But I always did believe in hitting something right, see. And when I fingered, I had to…
Crossed the river there one time.
